items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And there was a trumpet player. I don’t know what ever happened to him. His name was Mike Lawrence.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Joe Henderson. Wow, what a – Joe Henderson was amazing. I was really flattered to get that call to do the recording. Again, it was just very, very relaxed. It was Ron Carter. I’m trying to remember who the drummer was – Louis Hayes. Yeah,
Louis Hayes. And there was a trumpet player. I don’t know what ever happened to him. His name was Mike Lawrence.
Hmm. Wow, yeah, that’s a name that I’m not familiar with.
